01 / CONTEXT

The project

A healthcare CRM bringing provider leads, user assignments, calls, and follow-up activity into a business workspace. These describe the product scope; the completion of individual private features remains unconfirmed.

02 / PRODUCT SCOPE

What it covers

  • Healthcare provider lead management and lead assignment.
  • User dashboards, permissions, and sales activity tracking.
  • Calling workflows, provider history, follow-up scheduling, and notifications.

This describes the intended or related scope. It is not a claim that every feature is complete.

03 / CONTRIBUTION

My involvement

Developing a business CRM with a public authentication entry point. Internal workflows are behind sign-in, so their completion is not presented as verified.

04 / DEVELOPMENT DETAILS

Verified entry point & unconfirmed scope

  • Publicly viewable: branded sign-in screen, email and password inputs, and account recovery entry point.
  • Feature scope awaiting completion confirmation: lead management, role-based dashboards, permissions, calling workflows, provider history, follow-up scheduling, and notifications.
  • Implemented and planned internal features will be documented separately once confirmed.
